task: Loan amortization schedule with BigDecimal money, java.time due dates, Optional lookup and a checked InvalidLoanException
reasoning_summary: Tests were written first, covering a hand-checkable 10000@12%/12 first row, zero-rate remainder handling, month-end date clamping, Optional lookups and validation. The last installment pays off the exact remaining balance so rounding never leaves a residual. Due dates use firstPaymentDate.plusMonths(i) to avoid day drift.
